name: dark-extract
description: Dark fantasy multiplayer dungeon extraction game

scripts.dev: npm run build -w @dark-extract/shared && concurrently -n server,client -c blue,green "npm run dev -w @dark-extract/server" "npm run dev -w @dark-extract/client"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @dark-extract/shared && npm run build -w @dark-extract/server && npm run build -w @dark-extract/client
scripts.build:server: npm run build -w @dark-extract/shared && npm run build -w @dark-extract/server
